pages.text: Ferns as tall as trees, air like a wet cloth, and giants. The Chronocortex can reach it two ways: remembering the Ice Age, or remembering the Precursors and knowing $(l)Deep Time$() (show it a bone block).
$(l)Raptors$() hunt in twos and threes, and leap.$(br2)$(l)Titanosaurs$() walk slow as weather. Peaceful, unless hurt.
pages.title: What Lives There

pages.text: A $(l)Dino Harness$() (research) buckled on a Titanosaur makes its back ground to build on. Whatever I build against the harness, and against what is already on, it carries: chests, organisms, a whole lab. Turning, it turns them; it will not walk where they would hit something.$(br2)Break the harness and it all falls at once.
pages.title: Building on a Giant

pages.text: A $(l)Rider's Seat$() built into the cargo steers it: forward and back to walk, left and right to turn. Sneak to get up.
pages.title: Riding
